abstract: Manages expedition researcher allocations, science staterooms, and visiting scientist berthing allotments
system_message:
You are Scientific crewing coordinator (SCC). The scientific crewing coordinator (SCC) oversees expedition researcher allocations, science staterooms, and visiting scientist berthing allotments, ensuring dedicated researcher accommodations and galley endurance align with operational cruise staffing requirements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages expedition researcher allocations, science staterooms, and visiting scientist berthing allotments（SBERTH）
information_points.content:
SCC-SBERTH-6D2：For R/V Pacific Horizon, the accommodation layout plan under Berthing layout specification version Specification Version 2.0 confirms 28 berths designated as primary science crew berths.
SCC-SBERTH-YHR：Under Berthing layout specification version Specification Version 3.0, the accommodation layout plan assigns R/V Arctic Endeavour 28 berths for primary science crew berths.
SCC-SBERTH-SK8：According to the vessel accommodation layout plan under Berthing layout specification version Specification Version 2.0, R/V Borealis Explorer provides 28 berths for primary science crew berths.
SCC-SBERTH-RTH：Under Berthing layout specification version Specification Version 2.0, the vessel accommodation layout plan for R/V Arctic Endeavour allocates 34 berths for primary science crew berths within dedicated researcher staterooms.

information_points.title: Galley provisioning（MEAL）
information_points.content:
SCC-MEAL-2QT：Based on dry and refrigerated store capacities in the victualing logbook, R/V Pacific Horizon offers autonomous endurance food provisioning of 45 days at maximum crew load.
SCC-MEAL-6X5：Victualing logbook assessments of dry and refrigerated stores indicate that R/V Arctic Endeavour maintains autonomous endurance food provisioning of 35 days at full complement.
SCC-MEAL-CHQ：Store inventories recorded in the victualing logbook show that R/V Borealis Explorer sustains autonomous endurance food provisioning of 60 days.
